case_number: 2025 INSC 308; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(CRL.) NO(S). 8549 OF 2023)
summary: False promise of marriage as rape; prolonged consensual relationship v. sexual exploitation; false promise distinguishes consent; video blackmail and threats; miscarriage allegation dropped; co-accused exonerated; High Court refusal to quash not interfered; prosecution permitted to proceed.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.161, s.164, s.173(2)
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed in part; proceedings not quashed; prosecution for offences under Sections 376, 384, 323, 504, 506 IPC to proceed; other allegations dropped.
